g.id: cluster_Ticket store on the server (v1.3, Upstash Redis, kept seven days)
g.text: Ticket store on the server (v1.3, Upstash Redis, kept seven days)
bot_rules : string[] (sent to the model only)
status : urgent | needs human | answered | closed
bookingTime : string ("" when not a booking)
remote : true (v1.3, staff browser only, a ticket from another device)
frontdesk.alerts : "1" (v1.1, only when staff turn urgent alerts on)
frontdesk.notes : map of ticket id to note (v1.2, written only when a note is saved)
frontdesk.synckey : string (v1.3, this browser's private key for its own tickets)
frontdesk.alldevices : "1" (v1.3, while the staff switch "all devices" is on)
the ticket's fields (as Ticket, without remote)
owner : string (a hash of the browser key that created it)
One record per ticket for seven days.
The question, reply and patient never
change once stored. A merge keeps every
staff reply; the status further along wins.
A patient browser reads its own tickets
with its key; staff read the list with
the clinic's desk code, which the browser
human (v1.1, asks for a person) : needs human

the reply, kind and status never change.
